LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
Young Suns is a 1-4 player narrative life sim set after a successful revolution on Jupiter, intended for one-to-two hours of daily play alone or with friends.

Build your home among the stars, and take it with you on adventures!

FOLLOW OUR DEVELOPMENT—A GAME THAT GROWS ALONGSIDE YOU

👷🏽 Young Suns is actively developing. Players are encouraged to participate in the community and contribute feedback and suggestions.

🧑🏽‍🏭 Young Suns is synced to real-world time and is intended for one-to-two hours of daily play, completing daily and weekly quests from the friendly citizens of Jupiter, thoughtfully building up your perfect ship-home, and making new friends among the stars. 

🗓️ To follow our update roadmap, learn more about the game’s development, and join the community for support and feedback please visit www.youngsuns.com.

BE YOURSELF AMONG THE STARS—HELP BUILD A FUTURE FOR EVERYONE

The people of Jupiter are newly free from predatory corporate control, and they’ve entrusted you with your very own ship. Along the way, you’ll meet revolutionaries trying to find their place in a future they weren’t sure they’d live to see, navigate lingering conflicts between several factions who all have their own idea of the best path forward, and help the friendly Jovian citizens build a better tomorrow.

Explore moonlets, ruins, and stations with a crew of up to three friends, or entirely on your own, discovering and repairing broken items for your own use or to donate to the common good. Decorate and customize your spaceship. Build relationships with a huge cast of lovable characters. Help rebuild and improve society for everyone.

There’s a lot of work to be done if we want to make this a better world, and we can’t do it alone! 

KEY FEATURES

◌ 30 FULLY REALIZED CHARACTERS with unique looks, personalities, and histories. Learn their stories and help with the many problems faced by the people of Jupiter.

◌ CREATE YOUR CHARACTER and alter any aspect of your look during play—character creation is only the beginning. Discover and repair broken cosmetics, and craft your own to match your style.

◌ YOUR SHIP IS YOUR HOME. Personalize your spaceship with 80+ discoverable recipes and items. Paint the walls, stack your shelves—create your perfect cozy space.

◌ THAT’S NOT JUNK, IT’S TREASURE! Find and repair damaged furniture, clothing and tools. Use them yourself, gift them, or donate them to the common cause.

◌ GROW AND THRIVE. Upgrade your tools to perform harder jobs. Enhance and expand your ship. Build relationships with your fellow Jovians to improve the world around you/
◌ SPACE IS BEAUTIFUL. Fly your ship to fantastical moonlets, derelict ruins, and converted space stations on your journey through a newly-reclaimed region of Jovian space.

Full details on the latest status of the game, how you can give feedback and report issues can be found at www.youngsuns.com.

Features: Supports 1-4 players, journey through space solo or with friends
30 fully realized characters to learn from and build relationships with
Large free-roam area in the Jovian System to explore
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
1.0 Patch Notes

Young Suns is designed for 1-2 hours of daily play

Welcome to the Junk Drawer, Sundog!

With your trusty Jovipedia by your side, you'll explore and gather resources to decorate and expand your ship, and take it with you on adventures! During your travels, you'll learn more about the citizens of Jupiter and their hard-won revolution against their exploitative overlords, and help them figure out how to build a better world for everyone.

Play solo or with up to 3 friends for a chill experience navigating the Junk Drawer, an area of Jovian space hit hardest by corporate control. Meet charming characters, visit beautiful landscapes, and build your home among the stars as you create a brighter tomorrow.

With this update, so many systems have changed that unfortunately Game Preview save files will not be compatible. Don't worry as there's an all new flow to the game economy and collectibles!

Visit our website to check out our roadmap!

Highlights:
　◌ Get to know the revolutionaries of the Jovian System with daily and weekly jobs, all synced to a real-world clock
　◌ Spacefare in style with gorgeous new decoration sets for your ship
　◌ Bond with a dynamic cast of characters, each with reactive dialogue and new daily stories
　◌ Explore 12 new moonlets
　◌ Align with any of the 8 factions that suit you best, earning faction reputation and unlocking exclusive rewards
　◌ Scan the world to learn about the history of the Jovian System and its ecosystem
